title: The De Bruijn–Erdős Theorem on Incidence Geometry and Near-Pencil Tightness
summary: A complete machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the De Bruijn–Erdős theorem (1948) in incidence geometry and pairwise balanced block designs, together with its constructive near-pencil tightness proof. Proves that any finite linear space on n ≥ 3 non-collinear points determines at least n lines (|P| ≤ |L|) via the classical combinatorial double-counting inequality.
